title: Divide Chocolate
description: Divide a chocolate bar with sweetness levels into k+1 pieces to maximize the minimum sweetness among all pieces.
pseudocode:
1. low = min(sweetness), high = sum(sweetness) / (k + 1)
2. while low <= high:
3.   mid = (low + high) // 2
4.   if can_split(sweetness, k, mid):
5.     ans = mid, low = mid + 1
6.   else: high = mid - 1

steps.note: Initialize binary search range. Low=1, High=6.
Calculate mid = 3. Check if pieces with sweetness >= 3 can be formed.
can_split returns true. Pieces: [1+2=3], [3], [4], [5]. We have 4 pieces (k+1).
Valid mid found. Set ans=3, try higher: low = 4.
can_split returns false. We cannot form 2 pieces with sum >= 5.
